title: IdentitySteal
description: Mystery identity cards with unique role abilities for PvP gameplay — steal powers, summon allies, fake deaths, and more!
body:
![# IDENTITYSTEAL](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f2f2459d302e5abb89a1ac4e4765eaf5978fddf.jpeg) > *A dynamic identity system for Paper 1.21+ PvP servers — where every card grants unique powers and every role changes the battlefield.* ---
--- ## Overview **IdentitySteal** is a comprehensive role-based identity system designed for competitive PvP environments. Players receive **locked Identity Cards** granting persistent, unique abilities that fundamentally alter gameplay strategy. ### Key Features - **🎴 Identity Cards** — Permanently locked to your hotbar; each card provides a Primary (Right-Click) and Secondary (Shift + Right-Click) ability - **📈 Identity Evolution** — Earn XP through kills (+50) and ability usage (+10); reach 1,000 XP for Tier II evolution with 1.2x power scaling - **⚖️ Dynamic Distribution** — Balanced deck-style system ensuring diverse role representation across Tank, DPS, Support, and Utility categories - **🤝 Ally System** — Built-in ally selection GUI for team coordination --- ## Role Catalog ### DPS Roles #### **Blitz** — *Electro-Kinetic Striker* - **Primary: Blitz Mode** — Gain Speed V for 2s on every hit; every 3rd hit deals +3 bonus damage (5s internal cooldown) - **Secondary: Sonic Dash** — Launch forward 8 blocks via velocity; enemies in path receive Slowness V for 1.5s - **Cooldowns:** Primary (configurable) | Secondary: 12s #### **Frost** — *Tundra Master* - **Primary: Winter Spirit** — Manifest a localized blizzard leaving Ice Paths (Speed II); applies Slowness III and Weakness I; 4s exposure causes Deep Freeze (root) - **Secondary: Ice Wall** — Summon a 3×3 Packed Ice wall for projectile blocking #### **Rebel** — *Insurgent Leader* - **Primary: Rebel Uprising** — Summon vindicators that target your enemies - **Passive: Unyielding Will** — 5 auto-resurrections (Totem-style saves) #### **Ghost** — *Ethereal Wraith* - **Primary: Poltergeist** — Invisibility, Flight, Resistance II for 5s; breaks on damage - **Secondary: Possession** — Mount nearest enemy (5 block range); apply Blindness and Nausea for 3s - **Passive: Escape Instinct** — Speed II for 2s after taking damage (6s internal cooldown) --- ### Tank Roles #### **Pawn** — *Dimensional Manipulator* - **Primary: Dimension Shift** — Toggle between: - **Ant Mode:** 0.5× scale, Speed II, Jump II, −25% damage - **Titan Mode:** 2.0× scale, Strength II, Resistance II, −25% speed - **Secondary: Weight Shift** — Ant: directional launch | Titan: 6-block AoE stomp with knockback #### **Poseidon** — *Abyssal Sovereign* - **Primary: Sea Sovereign** — Riptide anywhere (no water required); drowning immunity; every 4th hit triggers Tidal Wave (knockback + bonus damage) - **Secondary: Whirlpool** — Vortex pulling enemies inward with Slowness IV #### **Forge** — *Combat Artificer* - **Primary: Overclock** — +20% attack damage, Resistance I, 50% knockback resistance - **Secondary: Master Repair** — Instantly restore 50% durability to armor and main-hand item - **Risk:** After Overclock expires, receive Slowness II and Weakness I for 4s #### **Anchor** — *Space-Time Architect* - **Primary: Set Anchor** — Place up to 6 temporary anchors - **Secondary: Warp Network** — GUI teleportation to any active anchor - **Passive: Waypoints** — Convert anchors into 5 permanent waypoints --- ### Support Roles #### **Healer** — *Celestial Guardian* - **Primary: Radiant Surge** — Gain Absorption (+4 hearts) until damage taken; cooldown: 15s - **Secondary: Sanctuary** — 5-block radius zone applying Regeneration I and Resistance I to allies only (not self) for 5s; cooldown: 20s #### **Prophet** — *Divine Sage* - **Primary: Divine Knowledge** — Access GUI of categorized Enchanted Books - **Passive: Fate's Bounty** — Individual 300s cooldowns per book type #### **Archivist** — *Forbidden Scholar* - **Primary: Scholarly Search** — Manifest Enchanting Shards (Lowly, Apprentice, or Master) - **Shard Transcendence** — Right-click shards to transform into enchanted tomes: - **Lowly:** Enchants Level I–III (vanilla range) - **Apprentice:** Enchants Level I–V (vanilla maximum) - **Master:** Enchants Level I–VI (+1 above vanilla cap) --- ### Utility Roles #### **Observer** — *Spectral Scout* - **Primary: Spectral View** — Enter Spectator Mode for 6–10s (random); enemies within 12 blocks of your body glow; exit bonus: Speed II (3s) + Glowing on nearby enemies (2.5s) - **Secondary: Reveal Pulse** — 14-block pulse applying Glowing to all enemies for 3s - **Passive: Awareness** — Every 4s, subtle warning (sound + particles) if enemies within 16 blocks #### **Imposter** — *Morphic Assassin* - **Passive: Identity Theft** — Kill a player to steal their identity abilities - **Ability: Mimicry** — Use stolen identity's Primary and Secondary abilities #### **Mirror** — *Shard of Reflection* - **Primary: Soul Reflection** — Copy a nearby player's identity (same chunk) - **Secondary: Mirrored Cast** — Execute the copied identity's Primary ability --- ## Administrative Features | Command | Permission | Description | |---------|------------|-------------| | `/identity give ` | `identitysteal.admin` | Assign specific identity | | `/identity remove ` | `identitysteal.admin` | Remove player's identity completely | | `/identity resetcooldown [role]` | `identitysteal.admin` | Reset cooldowns | | `/identity admin` | `identitysteal.admin` | Open live role editor GUI | | `/identity reload` | `identitysteal.admin` | Reload configuration | | `/identity roller [player]` | `identitysteal.admin` | Give Card Roller | | `/identity swapper [player] [amount]` | `identitysteal.admin` | Give Identity Swapper | ### PlaceholderAPI Support - `%identitysteal_role%` — Current role name - `%identitystebal_role_id%` — Role identifier - `%identitysteal_cooldown%` — Primary cooldown remaining - `%identitysteal_duration%` — Active duration remaining - Plus 6+ additional placeholders ### Technical Specifications - **Auto-Cleanup:** All temporary effects (flight, size, spectator, invisibility) removed on disconnect/death - **Data Persistence:** Player roles saved to YAML; restored on rejoin - **Performance:** Cached lookups, flicker-free scoreboard integration ---
